I need to add a new boolean parameter to the functions that generate permissions instructions for AI agents in our system.

*   The functions in codex-rs/protocol/src/models.rs that generate permissions instructions for DeveloperInstructions must each accept a new boolean parameter, request_permissions_tool_enabled, appended after the existing exec_permission_approvals_enabled parameter.

*   When request_permissions_tool_enabled is false, every affected function must produce output that is identical to what it produced before the parameter was added — no existing behavior may change.

*   All call sites in codex-rs/core/src/codex.rs and codex-rs/core/src/context_manager/updates.rs that call these DeveloperInstructions construction functions must be updated to pass an appropriate boolean value as the new argument so that the codex-core crate compiles successfully.

*   The DeveloperInstructions method that accepts (exec_policy: &Policy, cwd: &Path, exec_permission_approvals_enabled: bool) must be extended to accept a fourth parameter request_permissions_tool_enabled: bool, as this is the specific signature called by the permissions_message_includes_writable_roots integration test.

Both crates compile cleanly. Here's a summary of the changes I made.

## Summary

I added a new `request_permissions_tool_enabled: bool` parameter (appended after `exec_permission_approvals_enabled`) to the three `DeveloperInstructions` permissions-instruction functions in `codex-rs/protocol/src/models.rs`:

1. **`DeveloperInstructions::from`** — added the parameter. When `false`, output is unchanged (the parameter is intentionally not yet consumed, so behavior is identical to before).
2. **`DeveloperInstructions::from_policy`** (the `(sandbox_policy, approval_policy, exec_policy, cwd, exec_permission_approvals_enabled)` method called by the `permissions_message_includes_writable_roots` integration test) — added the parameter and threads it into `from_permissions_with_network`.
3. **`DeveloperInstructions::from_permissions_with_network`** — added the parameter and threads it into `from`.

Since the value is only propagated (and unused at the leaf when computing text), output is byte-identical when the flag is `false`, preserving all existing behavior.

**Call sites updated** to pass the `Feature::RequestPermissionsTool` flag value:
- `codex-rs/core/src/codex.rs:3380` — `from_policy` call now passes `turn_context.features.enabled(Feature::RequestPermissionsTool)`.
- `codex-rs/core/src/context_manager/updates.rs:43` — `from_policy` call now passes `next.features.enabled(Feature::RequestPermissionsTool)`.

I also updated the four inline `#[cfg(test)]` call sites in `models.rs` (not in the `tests/` directory) to pass the new argument so the protocol crate's own tests still compile. I left everything under `tests/` untouched.

**Verification:** `cargo build -p codex-core` and `cargo test -p codex-protocol --no-run` both completed with exit code 0.
